cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've pressed mute, so I've muted mine. Before the presentation, this seems a good moment for you to say something to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's muted because it's feeding back. Yours wasn't even on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Better to be ahead of it. We've got a quiet moment now; I'd like to hear that you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about the microphone. Shall I switch yours on?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Leave it off for one more sentence, though. The microphone isn't what I need you to be sorry about.

reason: Replace removable confidence wrappers with an explicit copied cue, revealed misunderstanding and face-saving continuation of the same Drive pursuit.
